claim.claim-text: 1. A compound helicopter (1) with at least one main rotor (2) and a fuselage (4) that extends along a longitudinal axis (1a) from a front fuselage section (4a) to a rear fuselage section (4b), comprising:

at least a first braced wing (5a) in joined-wing configuration and a second braced wing (5b) in joined-wing configuration, wherein the first braced wing (5a) comprises a first upper wing (6a) and a first lower wing (7a) which are interconnected in a first interconnection region (9c), and wherein the second braced wing (5b) comprises a second upper wing (6b) and a second lower wing (7b) which are interconnected in a second interconnection region (9d); and an emergency floatation system (3) with main floatation balloons (14a, 14b, 15a, 15b) and lateral floatation balloons (16a, 16b), wherein the main floatation balloons (14a, 14b, 15a, 15b) comprise at least one front floatation balloon (14a, 14b) that is arranged in the front fuselage section (4a) and at least one rear floatation balloon (15a, 15b) that is arranged in the rear fuselage section (4b), and wherein the lateral floatation balloons (16a, 16b) comprise at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) that is arranged close to the first interconnection region (9c) and at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b) that is arranged close to the second interconnection region (9d); wherein the at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) is mounted to the first lower wing (7a) and deployed toward the first upper wing (6a) in inflated state, or mounted to the first upper wing (6a) and deployed toward the first lower wing (7a) in inflated state; and wherein the at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b) is mounted to the second lower wing (7b) and deployed toward the second upper wing (6b) in inflated state, or mounted to the second upper wing (7b) and deployed toward the second lower wing (6b) in inflated state.

2. The compound helicopter (1) of claim 1, wherein the front fuselage section (4a) is located along the longitudinal axis (1a) ahead of the first braced wing (5a) and the second braced wing (5b), and wherein the rear fuselage section (4a) is located along the longitudinal axis (1a) behind the first braced wing (5a) and the second braced wing (5b).

3. The compound helicopter (1) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one front floatation balloon (14a, 14b) is mounted in the front fuselage section (4a) at a fuselage bottom border (4h) such that the at least one front floatation balloon (14a, 14b) extends in inflated state at least essentially away from the fuselage (4) along a transversal axis of the fuselage (4).

4. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one rear floatation balloon (15a, 15b) is mounted in the rear fuselage section (4b) at a fuselage bottom border (4h) such that the at least one rear floatation balloon (15a, 15b) extends in inflated state at least essentially away from the fuselage (4) along a transversal axis of the fuselage (4).

5. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the emergency floatation system (3) further comprises associated wing buoyancy volumes (12a, 12b, 13a, 13b) which are arranged inside of the first and second lower wings (7a, 7b).
6. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims,

wherein the at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) is mounted to the first lower wing (7a), and wherein the at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b) is mounted to the second lower wing (7b) ; and wherein the at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) is stored in uninflated state in a first jettisonable container unit (24c) that is mounted to and jettisonable from the first lower wing (7a), and wherein the at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b) is stored in uninflated state in a second jettisonable container unit (24d) that is mounted to and jettisonable from the second lower wing (7b).

7. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein a first lateral nacelle (9a) is mounted to the first interconnection region (9c), wherein a second lateral nacelle (9b) is mounted to the second interconnection region (9d), wherein a first propeller (8a) is mounted to the first lateral nacelle (9a), and wherein a second propeller (8b) is mounted to the second lateral nacelle (9b).

8. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the emergency floatation system (3) further comprises holding mechanisms (21a, 21b) which are mounted to the at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) and the at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b), wherein the holding mechanisms (21a, 21b) are adapted to hold the at least one first lateral floatation balloon (16a) and the at least one second lateral floatation balloon (16b) in inflated state in a predetermined position relative to the first braced wing (5a) and the second braced wing (5b).

9. The compound helicopter (1) of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the fuselage (4) is connected to a tail boom (4g), and wherein the emergency floatation system (3) further comprises an associated tail boom buoyancy volume (18) that is arranged inside of the tail boom (4g).
